## Is your feature request related to a problem?

A clear and concise description of what the problem is. Ex. I'm always frustrated when [...]

## Describe the solution you'd like

A clear and concise description of what you want to happen.

## Describe alternatives you've considered

A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Use Cases

Describe specific use cases or user stories:

- **User:** Who would use this?
- **Goal:** What would they accomplish?
- **Benefit:** Why is this valuable?

## Implementation Ideas (optional)

If you have ideas on how this could be implemented, describe them here.

## Affected Areas

- [ ] User Interface
- [ ] Product Catalog
- [ ] Shopping Experience
- [ ] Search/Filtering
- [ ] Cart/Checkout
- [ ] User Account
- [ ] Admin Panel
- [ ] Performance
- [ ] Accessibility
- [ ] Other: [Specify]

## Priority

- [ ] Low (Nice to have)
- [ ] Medium (Should have)
- [ ] High (Must have)

## Additional context

Add any screenshots, mockups, or other context about the feature request here.

## Related Issues

- Relates to: [Link to related issues if any]
